title: NMEA 2000
description: This device as a node on the NMEA 2000 bus. The instances tell it apart from other devices of the same kind; an MFD can also set them over the bus, and a value set there shows up here.

keys.name: device_instance
keys.title: Device instance
keys.description: Tells this device from others of the same type, e.g. a second switch bank. Every device of one type on a bus needs its own. Takes effect immediately: the device announces itself again with the new value.

keys.name: system_instance
keys.title: System instance
keys.description: Which of several separate systems on one bus this device belongs to. Leave at 0 unless the boat's installation uses system instances.
